text: At 82 minutes near the Redmond Rovers’ goal, Ironvale Athletic raise their defensive line and increase their pressing intensity across the center of the pitch. They switch to more direct, vertical passing aimed toward the Rovers’ penalty area at the far end. This tactical shift leads to more shots and touches inside the box as Ironvale pushes forward to chase the game[#1477].
